speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA-C).

The clinical picture of progressive parkinsonism (gait difficulty), autonomic failure (urinary incontinence), and pyramidal signs (speech slurring) strongly suggests MSA-C, a rare neurodegenerative disorder. I have already requested the necessary MRI imaging to confirm the characteristic "hot cross bun" sign and spinal cord changes.
